mentions.name: CloudCLI
mentions.description: This open-source web and mobile UI lets developers control AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex, and Gemini) from any device. Running npx @siteboon/claude-code-ui discovers existing sessions from ~/.claude/projects/ and provides a browser interface to fully control them remotely. It is open source and has grown to about 8.2k GitHub stars.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to develop from a phone while working on another project; Anthropic's Remote Control launch only allows viewing and approving sessions, not fully controlling an instance.
